title.zh: ElevenLabs打包语音Agent：支持90多种语言，兼容OpenAI接口
title.en: ElevenLabs打包语音Agent：支持90多种语言，兼容OpenAI接口

current_state.zh: ElevenLabs launched Eleven Realtime (Mini and Max), a packaged real-time speech model for voice agents supporting 90+ languages and 17,000+ voices, with an OpenAI WebSocket-compatible Realtime API and benchmark accuracy of 98.8% at 0.57s response latency.
